title: Terraform module: VPC network topology templates with proactive route health checks
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Objective: Create a reusable Terraform module that provides opinionated VPC topology templates (single-az, multi-az public/private, and isolated-private) plus proactive route health checks and automated egress failover wiring. The module should be consumable by Redwood Private deploys and support safe upgrades across customer stacks.

Scope:
- Module exports a set of topology_templates variable (e.g. 'public-single-az', 'private-multi-az', 'isolated-private') and composes: VPC, subnets (public/private/isolated), IGW, NAT gateways (with optional NAT Gateway autoscaling pattern), VPC endpoints (interface & gateway), route tables and route associations, and a lightweight route-health check resource.
- Route health checks implement periodic synthetic probes (Lambda or managed probe agent) to validate NAT/IGW/eP connectivity and emit CloudWatch metrics and alarms. On critical failure the module outputs signals usable by orchestration to update routing (eg. re-point private route to standby NAT or to egress VPC endpoint).
- Backwards-compatible variables for customers that already use our older vpc modules: include opts to supply existing route table IDs, subnet IDs, or skip resource creation.

Design decisions & trade-offs:
- Probe implementation: choose a minimal Lambda that creates TCP/HTTP probes to endpoints through the candidate egress path (NAT IP, IGW egress, or endpoint IP) and writes a binary healthy/unhealthy metric. Advantage: provider-agnostic and low infra footprint. Trade-off: introduces Lambda and CloudWatch dependency in private/on-prem variants. For air-gapped customers we provide a no-probe mode and a local healthcheck script.
- Egress failover: module will not perform automatic route mutation by default (safety). Instead it will produce an actionable output and a controlled optional submodule (enable_failover = true) that performs route updates via IAM-backed step function/Lambda. This avoids surprising production failovers.
- State & upgrades: design for rolling changes via semantic versioning. Avoid resource renames; include 'resource_migration' notes and migration helpers (import guidance) in README.

Acceptance criteria:
- Module can create all topology templates in a controlled test account and pass terratest end-to-end (subnets present, route tables correct, endpoints created).
- Probe Lambda emits health metric and an alarm triggers when probe fails 3x in a 5 minute window.
- Optional failover wiring can switch the route to standby NAT in a test harness without manual terraform state surgery.
- Module includes documentation for upgrades, import examples for existing networks, and CI pipeline that runs plan/apply in ephemeral accounts.

Implementation plan (high level):
1) Module skeleton and variables, provider pinning and semantic version file (v0.1.0 initial).
2) Implement topology templates and resource creation (VPC, subnet, route tables, IGW/NAT/EIPs).
3) Implement VPC endpoints creation + policy options (S3 gateway endpoints, interface endpoints subset).
4) Implement the probe Lambda and CloudWatch metric + alarm. Make probe optional via variable.
5) Implement 'enable_failover' opt-in submodule with IAM role and step-function/Lambda that updates route tables when alarm fires.
6) Add terratest/kitchen-terraform cases and integrate into CI.
7) Write migration notes, README, examples, and rollout plan.

Compatibility notes:
- Provider: aws >= 4.0, recommended 4.22.0.
- Output compatibility with existing consumers: provide outputs.old_public_subnets, outputs.old_private_subnets mapping if detect_legacy_names = true.

Sample variables snippet (for README):
variable "topology_template" { type = string default = "private-multi-az" }
variable "enable_probe" { type = bool default = true }
variable "enable_failover" { type = bool default = false }

Outputs (examples):
- public_subnet_ids, private_subnet_ids, isolated_subnet_ids
- primary_nat_gateway_id, standby_nat_gateway_ids
- route_health_metric_namespace, route_health_alarm_name

Migration & upgrade guidance:
- Provide an automated plan helper 'migration_helper.sh' that shows resources to import and generates terraform import commands for common patterns.
- Keep default names stable. If a breaking rename is required, increment major version and provide clear step-by-step import instructions and an audit checklist for customer ops.

Monitoring & observability:
- CloudWatch metrics and dashboards exported by module (optional).
- Console integration: add telemetry hook to Redwood Console for private deployments so infra teams can see probe health and failover status.

Security & compliance:
- Minimum IAM surface for probe/failover: least-privilege role that can describe/modify route tables when enable_failover=true.
- KMS usage where EIPs or other secrets are stored (if any).

Rollout:
- Start with internal staging accounts, then enable as A/B in 3 pilot customers (low-risk) before general availability.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Create each topology template in a test account successfully. 2) Probe Lambda emits health metric and CloudWatch alarm triggers on sustained failures. 3) Optional failover submodule performs route swap in test harness. 4) Terratest cases pass in CI. 5) README covers migration examples and upgrade notes.
